headline: India's CoinDCX Curbs Crypto Futures Following Binance Liquidity Disruption
summary: India's largest crypto exchange has restricted new futures positions after a security incident at Binance disrupted a key liquidity provider. The platform stated that customer funds, deposits, and withdrawals remain unaffected.
why: Crypto exchanges rely on external liquidity providers and counterparties to execute trades and maintain market depth. Operational disruptions at major global platforms can create cascading liquidity issues across smaller regional exchanges.
